Running locally: Same key works everywhere. Store it as an environment variable (NVIDIA_API_KEY) rather than pasting it into code.

rich.28538d8a6c36.source: The session key is all the client sends to identify a conversation. From that one string the gateway resolves the full session server-side before every call, so the client never has to ship the transcript itself. Any two keys that differ at all address two separate sessions even when the conversations behind them hold identical content.
rich.28538d8a6c36.value: 用戶端只傳送會話金鑰來標識對話。每次呼叫前，閘道都會根據這一個字串在伺服器端解析出完整會話，因此用戶端無需自行傳送對話記錄。任何兩個存在差異的金鑰都會指向兩個不同的會話，即使它們背後的對話內容完全相同。

rich.2edde5d86458.source: Anyone who can read the launchable environment can read that token, and a reader of the token is an operator with everything above. Module 4 turns this from a convenience into the central security question.
rich.2edde5d86458.value: 任何能夠讀取 launchable 環境的人都能讀取該 token，而 token 的讀取者就是擁有上述所有權限的 operator。模組 4 將把這個便利機制轉化為核心安全問題。

rich.32c87b138c97.source:
Reaching the launchable and operating its gateway require separate credentials:

  • Launchable access. The browser session reaches the host.
  • Gateway authority. The gateway token authorizes JSON-RPC calls.

After launchable authentication, GET /api/agent returns the gateway token under agent.dashboardUrl. Leave the token field blank and let the probe fill it in.
rich.32c87b138c97.value:
存取可啟動執行個體和操作其閘道需要兩套獨立憑證：

  • 可啟動執行個體存取憑證。瀏覽器會話用於存取主機。
  • 閘道權限。閘道 token 用於授權 JSON-RPC 呼叫。

可啟動執行個體完成身分驗證後，GET /api/agent 會透過 agent.dashboardUrl 傳回閘道 token。請將 token 欄位留空，由探測工具自動填充。

rich.35b160c0dbd4.source: If the NemoClaw check times out or returns a 502. The agent harness likely has not finished booting, which usually means the launchable started before OpenClaw finished loading its policy YAML. Wait 30 seconds and test again. If it stays down, use the Recover cell in the gateway section below before continuing.
rich.35b160c0dbd4.value: 如果 NemoClaw 檢查超時或傳回 502。代理程式測試工具可能尚未完成啟動。這通常是因為 launchable 啟動時，OpenClaw 還未完成其策略 YAML 的載入。請等待 30 秒後再次測試。如果服務仍未恢復，請先使用下方閘道部分中的 Recover 單元，再繼續操作。

rich.4efe9c20b838.source: In this lesson, you will connect the browser to the launchable, inspect its four connection paths, use one direct model call as a control, send a tool-using agent turn through the gateway, and prove that a sessionKey restores history the client did not resend.
rich.4efe9c20b838.value: 本課中，您將連線瀏覽器與可啟動執行個體，檢查其四條連線路徑，以一次直接模型呼叫作為對照，透過閘道傳送會使用工具的代理程式輪次，並驗證 sessionKey 能恢復用戶端沒有重新傳送的歷史記錄。

rich.4f2589a3d249.value: 使用不同金鑰：全新開始，不繼承任何內容。

rich.d800d685f0e6.source: Step 1 established the model-only control: one Chat Completions POST carried the model, messages, and caller authorization. OpenClaw calls its configured model inside the launchable, but this page operates the running agent through a different interface.
rich.d800d685f0e6.value: 步驟 1 建立了僅使用模型的對照：一次 Chat Completions POST 攜帶模型、訊息和呼叫方授權資訊。OpenClaw 會在可啟動執行個體內呼叫已設定的模型，但本頁面透過另一個介面操作正在執行的代理程式。

rich.e6ec9c72041f.source: REST (Representational State Transfer). The direct model control in Step 1 uses one bounded HTTP request and response. An API can still identify server-side state between calls.
rich.e6ec9c72041f.value: REST（表述性狀態轉移）。步驟 1 的直接模型對照使用一次獨立的 HTTP 請求與回應。API 仍然可以識別呼叫之間由伺服器端儲存的狀態。

rich.e8a5c7f97701.source: Cause: toolSearch lets the model reach its tools by writing code for a bridge (tool_search_code · “run bridge code”), and the model loops on that bridge instead of calling exec.
rich.e8a5c7f97701.value: 原因：toolSearch 允許模型透過為橋接器編寫程式碼（tool_search_code · “執行橋接程式碼”）來存取工具，導致模型在該橋接器上反覆迴圈，而不呼叫 exec。

rich.eed8805240f3.source: The access session, an _pomerium or CF_Authorization browser cookie, authorizes reaching the launchable at all.
rich.eed8805240f3.value: 存取會話是名為 _pomerium 或 CF_Authorization 的瀏覽器 Cookie，用於授權存取 launchable 本身。

rich.eef3154c49c6.source: chat.send with a sessionKey drops a message straight into the running agent's loop.
rich.eef3154c49c6.value: 帶有 chat.send 的 sessionKey 會將訊息直接送入正在執行的代理程式迴圈。

rich.f32a85bda16a.source: OpenShell sandbox. Limits what the running agent can reach.
rich.f32a85bda16a.value: OpenShell sandbox。限制執行中的代理程式可以存取的範圍。

rich.f3bbda749211.source: LLM endpoint. Turns prompts and tool results into semantic responses, but does not retain the agent's session state.
rich.f3bbda749211.value: LLM API 端點。將提示詞和工具結果轉換為語義回應，但不儲存代理程式的會話狀態。
